job_title: Photo Retoucher/Image Editor ( Prepress And Image Production )
benefits: Fair and competitive salary: Based on experience (100% offered during the probation period)
Annual performance review and two performance reviews in the first year
100% full salary social insurance, premium healthcare insurance and annual health check
Full paid leave for 15 days per year
Full salary for sick leaves with doctor’s notes
Modern working equipment provided for an efficient workflow.
Training and career development opportunities: English class, technical workshops, requested online courses
Quarterly team bonding budget, Team retreats, company trips, and regular creative meetups
description:
* Process tasks and projects according to assignment, collaborating closely with colleagues from all Laudert locations.
* Perform image retouching, creation, including complex and high-end retouches.
* Perform image editing in the context of a layout design.
* Create print-ready data such as PDFs according to briefing requirements
* Work with automation and dynamic workflows for page related media production
* Take full responsibility for the quality of your work and the results delivered.
* Execute each task exactly as defined in the briefing, using the specified workflows and systems.
* Immediately and proactively raise questions or concerns to the Team Lead
* Inform the Team Lead proactively if a task may take longer than the estimated or pre-defined time.
* Perform quality checks by comparing the final results with the briefing and issuing correction instructions when needed
* Contribute actively to team efforts by supporting colleagues to ensure tasks and projects are completed on time and at the required quality
requirements_text:
Must have:
* Comprehensive expertise in common tools and applications for content/media production: Adobe Creative Cloud, focusing Photoshop and InDesign
* Demonstrates conversational English proficiency in both casual and professional settings
* Willingness to learn new tools or applications that are not yet part of your portfolio.
* Team player, sense of responsibility, and strong quality focus.
* Neutral and objective behavior when performing quality checks and issuing corrections.
* Empathy and professionalism in professional and interpersonal discussions
* A good and natural eye for colors, light, shading, and composition.
* High self-demand for quality, attention to detail, and careful reading of briefings.
* Organized and structured, especially in file management systems.
* Comfortable working in an international and multicultural team environment
* Responsibility and accountability for produced results.
Nice to have:
* Skilled in other Adobe Creative Cloud applications such as Illustrator; agentic and generative AI tools, Figma
* Ability to prompt and use AI tools for content creation support effectively.
* Strong technical expertise in media production workflows and delivery output standards.
* Natural sense for graphic design and creative work such as e.g layouting and art directive tasks
* Is equipped with a shared set of media related vocabulary
* Basic understanding of an economic working style (cost – time relation)
Kỹ năng cần có
Adobe Photoshop, Retouch, English A2-B1
Kỹ năng nên có
Illustrator, AI, InDesign
